data.narrative:
EraDrive is a private Space & Aerospace company founded by Sumant Sharma, Justin Kruger, and Simone D'Amico at an undisclosed stage and valuation. The sector contains 13 comparable companies (5 public, 8 private), including public peers RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, and SATL, and private peers such as SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Standard valuation triangulation methods are not applicable to this analysis. Peer-median multiples cannot be derived: although 14 same-sector peers exist, none satisfy narrow screening criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier datapoints). Public-comp anchoring cannot proceed because EraDrive's revenue is not on file. The Space & Aerospace public median P/S multiple is 25.3x across 6 tickers, but lacks a target revenue input to operationalize.

Without disclosed financials, stage clarity, or a sufficiently dense peer set at EraDrive's specific positioning, quantitative valuation synthesis is not supported by available data. Further work requires either target revenue disclosure, more granular stage taxonomy within the private peer set, or additional comparable-company datapoints at the same development tier. Key uncertainties are EraDrive's current revenue run rate, capital requirements, and competitive positioning relative to the identified private peer universe.
